E1.back: From now on, written only once
E1.note: No subject and no 你, so it is a nickname and not an instruction; 更新 is left out because the badge right above already reads 重大更新.

E2.text: 一条回复只存一次，每次用都换上对方的名字。
E2.back: One reply is saved only once, and every time it is used it takes on the other person's name.
E2.note: One short sentence in two halves joined by a comma, the ordinary Chinese way; 对方 is what a person says for whoever they are writing to.

E3.text: Cutling 会先问对方的名字，自己填上当天的日期，再把其余内容全部输入。回复只用写一次，之后不必再动手改。
E3.back: Cutling first asks for the other person's name, fills in that day's date by itself, and then types all the rest. A reply only needs writing once, and afterwards there is no more correcting it by hand.
E3.note: 先……再 carries the order (ask, then type) without connectors; 自己填上 is used for 'by itself' in place of the maker's word 自动.

E3s.text: Cutling 会先问对方的名字，自己填上当天的日期，再把其余内容全部输入。回复只写一次就够。Cutling 现在有黑五优惠。
E3s.back: Cutling first asks for the other person's name, fills in that day's date by itself, and then types all the rest. Writing the reply once is enough. Cutling has a Black Friday offer now.
E3s.note: 黑五 is the name mainland shoppers use for the sale; the full 黑色星期五 reads like a news item.

E2s.text: 一条回复每次用都换上新名字，现在还有优惠。
E2s.back: One reply takes on a new name every time it is used, and there is an offer on now too.
E2s.note: 还有 joins the sale to the first half as a second piece of news, so the line stays one sentence.

N_ios.text:
回复写一次，发给谁都能用。现在剪切片段里可以留填空，把每次不一样的部分空出来，比如对方的名字、订单号。轻点这样的剪切片段，Cutling 键盘会先问你名字，还会列出你以前用过的名字，轻点一下就能选，然后输入完整的回复。你也可以先打出名字，再轻点剪切片段。

日期不用你管。剪切片段里可以放今天的日期、明天的日期、一周后的日期或当前时间，到用的那天，出来的都是对的。它还能让你在几个选项里挑一个，比如“标准版”和“专业版”，也能带入你最近一次复制的文字，或者把光标停在你想接着打字的地方。编辑剪切片段时，这些都在“变量”按钮里。你自己打的花括号还是普通文字，所以已有的剪切片段用起来和以前一样。

写剪切片段就像在 Apple 的“备忘录”里写东西一样，不用另外学。剪切片段的文字现在会单独打开一页，可以用粗体、斜体、下划线、删除线、高亮、等宽字体和链接，也可以用项目符号列表、短划线列表和编号列表。

容量大了很多。文本剪切片段能存 5,000 条，图片能存 500 张，以前是 100 条和 25 张。一条剪切片段最多可以有 10,000 个字符，放一整封邮件也够。

Cutling 键盘上的每个键现在都能输入。带格式的剪切片段，轻点后和其他的一样直接输入，按住则连格式一起复制。

如果你一直没把 Cutling 键盘添加完，在 Cutling 里打开“键盘设置”就行。新的指南用一段短视频演示“设置”App 里的三个步骤。
N_ios.back:
Write a reply once and it works for whoever you send it to. A cutling can now have a blank left in it, leaving empty the part that differs each time, such as the other person's name or an order number. Tap such a cutling and the Cutling keyboard first asks you for the name, and also lists the names you used before so one tap picks one, then types the complete reply. You can also type the name first and then tap the cutling.

Dates need nothing from you. A cutling can hold today's date, tomorrow's date, the date a week from now or the current time, and on the day you use it what comes out is right. It can also let you pick one of several options, such as 'Standard' and 'Pro', bring in the text you copied most recently, or leave the cursor where you want to go on typing. While you edit a cutling, all of these are in the 'Variables' button. Curly braces you typed yourself are still ordinary text, so the cutlings you already have work as they did before.

Writing a cutling is just like writing in Apple's Notes, with nothing extra to learn. A cutling's text now opens as a page of its own, where you can use bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, monospaced type and links, and also bulleted, dashed and numbered lists.

There is far more room. You can keep 5,000 text cutlings and 500 images, where it used to be 100 and 25. One cutling can be up to 10,000 characters, enough even for a whole email.

Every key on the Cutling keyboard now types. A cutling with formatting types straight in like the others when tapped, and touching and holding it copies it together with its formatting.

If you never finished adding the Cutling keyboard, just open 'Keyboard Setup' in Cutling. The new guide shows the three steps in the Settings app as a short video.
N_ios.note: 你 throughout, spoken register (不用你管, 就行), mainland punctuation with “ ” around button names as the app's newer strings use; list names are the ones Apple's zh-CN Notes guide prints.

N_mac.text:
回复写一次，发给谁都能用。现在剪切片段里可以留填空，把每次不一样的部分空出来，比如对方的名字、订单号。用 ⌘⇧V 选中这样的剪切片段，粘贴之前会先弹出一个简短的表单问你名字，以前用过的名字点一下就能选。

日期不用你管。今天的日期、明天的日期、一周后的日期或当前时间，到用剪切片段的那天，出来的都是对的。剪切片段还能让你在几个选项里挑一个，比如“标准版”和“专业版”，也能带入你最近一次复制的文字。编辑剪切片段时，这些都在文字正下方的“添加变量”按钮里。你自己打的花括号还是普通文字，所以已有的剪切片段粘贴出来和以前一样。

容量大了很多。文本剪切片段能存 5,000 条，图片能存 500 张，以前是 100 条和 25 张。一条剪切片段最多可以有 10,000 个字符，放一整封邮件也够。
N_mac.back:
Write a reply once and it works for whoever you send it to. A cutling can now have a blank left in it, leaving empty the part that differs each time, such as the other person's name or an order number. Pick such a cutling with ⌘⇧V and, before it pastes, a short form pops up asking you for the name, and the names you used before can be picked with one click.

Dates need nothing from you. Today's date, tomorrow's date, the date a week from now or the current time come out right on the day you use the cutling. A cutling can also let you pick one of several options, such as 'Standard' and 'Pro', or bring in the text you copied most recently. While you edit a cutling, all of these are in the 'Add Variable' button directly below the text. Curly braces you typed yourself are still ordinary text, so the cutlings you already have paste the same as before.

There is far more room. You can keep 5,000 text cutlings and 500 images, where it used to be 100 and 25. One cutling can be up to 10,000 characters, enough even for a whole email.
N_mac.note: Same voice as the iPhone text; 点一下 stands for the click, since 轻点 belongs to a touch screen.
